log.label: Collar Tie
log.reason: Frame at ts shows the pair already clinched with Tommy's (pale-skinned) arm around Davis's neck pulling his head down -- matches label/actor/type, and feeds coherently into Tommy's own guard pull moments later.

log.label: Guard Pull
log.reason: One athlete drops to the mat immediately after the tie while the other stays standing; consistent with Tommy going to bottom voluntarily. No narration in this window, position/timing support the call.

log.label: Open Guard
log.reason: Continuous ground engagement right after the guard pull, both players working legs/hips from the same bottom/top arrangement established at 19675.

log.label: Leg Entanglement
log.reason: Frame shows both players' legs interlocked on the mat, consistent with a leg entanglement guard continuing from the open guard sequence.

log.label: Top Control
log.reason: Frame shows Davis (dark-skinned) on top holding a leg/control position over Tommy; narration at ts: 'fighters on top on top on top, he's still on top' -- matches actor/type.

log.label: 50/50 Guard
log.reason: Frame shows both entangled with interlocked legs perpendicular to each other, the classic 50/50 shape, following directly from Davis's leg-control period -- matches Tommy re-establishing guard.

log.label: Back Take
log.reason: Frame shows the pale-skinned athlete (Tommy) wrapped around the dark-skinned athlete's (Davis) back/torso from behind; crowd reaction ('Hallelujah! [Applause]') at 19975 fits a significant positional gain.

log.label: Back Control
log.reason: Scoreboard itself changes to 'T. LILLESKOG LANGAK: 3' exactly at this ts, matching the logged points=3 for back control -- as direct as evidence gets.

log.label: Body Triangle
log.reason: Same frame as Back Control shows Tommy's legs locked around Davis's body from the back -- consistent with a simultaneous body triangle.

log.label: Rear Naked Choke
log.reason: Frame at ts shows Tommy's arm across Davis's neck/jaw from the back-control position established at 19990, immediately preceding the tap and match end -- matches the published SUBMISSION win type.

log.label: Tap
log.reason: Match visibly ends: by 20005-20015 both corners are on the mat and Tommy is celebrating; final scoreboard 0-3 and win_type=SUBMISSION for Tommy match the published record.
